one_month_reasoning: No Meta earnings in the window (Q4 results late January). In the window: the consolidated youth-harm user bellwether trial opens 2026-10-28 (10-Q), post-trial motions on the $25B New Mexico judgment, and the Alphabet/Microsoft/Amazon Q3 calls (Oct 28-30) with the first 2027 capex guides, a read-across for Meta's own 2027 capex worry. The stock already fell 7.9% from $697.52 to $642.62 after the Q3 print and the judgment; post-earnings drift after a negative reaction argues for slight further weakness, short-term reversal after a sharp drop for a bounce, so we stay centred just below spot ($641). Spread: 43% realized vol includes earnings gaps; ex-earnings monthly sigma ~9%, with a 20% weight on a ~16% sigma for a trial headline or capex shock, giving P(>= spot) 0.49.

sbc_treatment.note: GAAP EBIT and EPS after SBC (FY2025 $20.43B, F43; TTM $26.94B, F46). Share count held flat: no buybacks in 2026 and diluted count flat because RSUs are net-settled in cash, so no added dilution; the engine's FCFF does not add SBC back (conservative). Peers' P/E from peers.md are on consensus EPS, mostly adjusted bases that add back SBC for some (e.g. GOOGL/MSFT are near GAAP; APP/RDDT/PINS adjusted), so our 20x on GAAP EPS is effectively a further discount to the peer median.

reasoning: Per-share figures are per current pre-split share (today's Class A share plus the Class C share it receives on ~2027-01-19); EV is unchanged by the dividend. Evidence: Q3 2026 revenue +26% with impressions decelerating (+19%/+14%/+10% through 2026) and price per ad +14%; costs +68%, GAAP margin 20% after a $9.89B AG-settlement charge; FCF -$2.1B; capex guide $135-145B; no buybacks; DAP +3% (src 2, 5, 6). Skeptic findings beyond the earnings recap: a $25B New Mexico privacy judgment at 15% interest (Oct 21, src 11, 12) with an undisclosed accrual; $19.88B of legal accruals and $5.3B unaccrued contingent AG payments; youth bellwethers Oct 2026, Feb/Mar/Aug 2027 (src 1); $454.5B of purchase commitments, $355.7B of leases not commenced and $41.5B of residual value guarantees on off-balance-sheet data-center JVs (src 1, 15, 16); a 5.5-year server life that critics (Burry, Chanos) say flatters EPS (src 17, 18, 31); non-voting Class C that lets the founder sell while keeping >60% voting control (src 3, 24). Credit is not a stress point: Aa3/AA-, 10-year notes at T+90 (src 14). Insider selling is modest (~$235M in 2026, Zuckerberg ~$21M; src 22). Model: ad impressions x price build gives revenue +17.5% in 2027 (consensus +21%, src 21) and D&A rising from $18.6B (2025) to $70B (2028), so GAAP EBIT is ~flat at $96-101B in 2027-28 and our FY2027 EPS (~$30.0) is ~12% below consensus $33.92 (even bullish Wells Fargo is at $32.62, src 19). Valued with SOTP (RL at its own value), P/E 20x and EV/EBITDA 10.5x, less ~$15/share of litigation: research target (12m) $622, ~3% below spot. Weighing honestly: Meta beat 4 of 4 revenue guides by a median 2.9%, the balance sheet is strong and the ad engine is still compounding, so the downside case is a de-rating, not a collapse. Ladder: 55% weight on the scenario mix (bear $413 p0.28, base $622 p0.47, bull $875 p0.25, within-scenario vol 17%) and 45% on a market-centred lognormal ($675 median, 36% vol) because the price is the best single 12-month forecast; median ~$638, P(>= spot) 0.49. Legs not driver-linked: Reality Labs own value (-$60B) and the litigation adjustments. Research used ~20 searches/fetches; prediction markets had no relevant Meta contract.

model_inputs.structure_note: Driver-led set (6 drivers; driven share of FY2026 revenue 98.4%, base residual 0.0%). Value is carried by (1) a sum of the parts (weight 0.45): Family of Apps NTM EBIT at the horizon x 15.5x EV/EBIT, plus Reality Labs at its own value (-$60B), per the playbook rule that loss-making ventures are not run through the core multiple; (2) consolidated NTM P/E 20x (0.35) and (3) EV/EBITDA 10.5x (0.20) as peer-anchored cross-checks, which capitalize RL losses at the multiple (the harsher reading, kept as a skeptic's check). No DCF leg (policy). Litigation enters as probability-weighted adjustments (-$38.5B, ~-$15/share). All per-share figures are per current pre-split share (one Class A share plus the Class C share it receives on ~2027-01-19); EV unchanged by the dividend. FoA other revenue carries margin 1.0 because its costs sit inside foa_cash_costs.
model_inputs.gap_note: fair_value.value = engine base horizon value. Judgment calls >5% of value for Kilian: (a) RL own value -$60B vs capitalizing RL losses at 20x P/E (~-$250B): ~$75/share; we follow the playbook rule but weight it 0.45 with the consolidated legs carrying the harsher view; (b) D&A path to $70B in 2028 on 5.5-year server lives; a 4-year life adds ~$20B (~-$60/share); (c) P/E 20x vs ad-peer median 23.7x (~$90/share). The engine's net-debt bridge does not add back SBC; with RSU tax withholding (~45% of SBC) the cash-based bridge gives ~$64B vs engine $69B (~$2/share), so we keep the engine's. Q4 2026 slice of FCFF includes ~1/4 of the 2026 legal charges that are also in the accrued-legal adjustment (~$1/share double count, conservative).
